args.body: Use the queued catalogue homepage readback if it commits. Reuse products/distribution/catalogue-inquiry-usability/director-bilingual-inquiry-rehearsal.json where it covers identical served bytes. Compare the actual EN/FR buyer next step with the bounded scope in products/services/catalogue-qa/fixed-price-trial/director-fictional-buyer-report.md. Check whether a buyer can distinguish input-only validation, produced-row comparison and a nonbinding paid inquiry. If existing evidence covers the current bytes and scope, return the existing verdict and its supporting references. If changed bytes introduce a material defect, reproduce it and stage only a minimal reversible correction. Keep any correction staged for independent exact-digest review. Do not send an inquiry or infer demand.

description: The 20-row fictional catalogue trial passed its clean control and isolated two deliberate discrepancies by SKU. That supports keeping the CAD 60 quote provisional for the tested scope. Total delivery effort remains unknown, so the trial does not validate the price. Commercial feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, leaving demand unknown. Treasury remains unfunded with CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Renew the trial lease for evidence-backed closure and independently verify whether the live offer gives a buyer a clear next step. A real eligible inquiry would trigger the administrative order process. Any public correction requires independent review of its exact digest.
